description: This file defines a factory interface for creating MQTT v3 clients within the HiveMQ MQTT client integration. It extends a generic MQTT client factory interface and specifies the MQTT 3 specific client types.

classes.name: HiveMqtt3ClientFactory
classes.description: An interface for a factory that creates MQTT 3 clients, specifically Mqtt3AsyncClient and uses Mqtt3ClientBuilder for configuration.

methods.name: HiveMqtt3ClientFactory
methods.description: Interface declaration for a factory that creates MQTT 3 client instances.
